text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 10 · 旧宅里的棋局室.
Environment:  A bright enclosed bay-window game room in a weathered Victorian manor, cream paneled walls, honey oak floor, curved windows overlooking a pale foggy garden. Small round walnut chess table with only simple abstract geometric chess pieces, two empty oatmeal upholstered chairs, one chair subtly pulled back. A closed door at rear, an old wall clock, landscape map behind glass, low bookcase. Front-center space clear. Quiet narrative tension through object placement, soft ivory daylight and warm brown, no dark gothic gloom or knives.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 10 · 旧宅里的棋局室. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
